printed_prose_rows.literal: 后会聚成实像（图174а）. 当光源位于比焦点更近的地方时，
折射光线就发散，而且得到的是虚像（图174б）.
发散透镜　用发散透镜可以做同样的实验. 把透镜固定
在圆盘中心，让平行于主光轴的光线射向透镜. 折射光线将
发散（图175），而它们的延长线将相交于发散透镜的主焦点.
它是虚像（图176а），并且与透镜的距离为 $F$. 如果透镜两边
的媒质是一样的，则第二个虚主焦点位于跟透镜等距的另一
透镜的光焦度　焦距的倒数值叫做透镜的光焦度，用字
emphasis: 焦距的倒数值叫做透镜的光焦度

printed_prose_rows.literal: 透镜的两焦点距透镜越近，透镜会聚光线或者发散光线
的折射作用越强，透镜光焦度的绝对值也越大.
透镜的光焦度 $D$ 用屈光度表示. 焦距为 1 米的透镜具有
的屈光焦度为 1 屈光度.

source_inventory: Two side-by-side diagrams, left а and right б; each contains one outlined biconcave lens with diagonal hatch-like marks inside.

Left а: three parallel incident solid rays directed from left to right; the central ray follows the axis, while the upper and lower rays spread to the right after the lens. Dashed backward extensions meet at a small outlined focal circle to the left, labelled F.

Right б: three parallel incident solid rays directed from right to left; the upper and lower rays spread to the left after the lens. Dashed backward extensions meet at a small outlined focal circle to the right, labelled F.
The central solid rays, all arrowheads, lens outlines and internal marks, dashed extensions, two F labels, two outlined focal circles and both Cyrillic subfigure markers must be retained together.
